Ideal-closure sizes, inclusion-maximal objects, intersections and normalizers quantify substantial structural distinctions: for q=3,m=1, 292 abelian subalgebras versus 7 abelian ideals, and for q=3,m=2, 5,134,432 versus 217. The claim includes every extension degree rather than one arbitrary finite table.
